newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Transportation, Precept to merge.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Transportation, Precept to merge.

text.p: U.S. Transportation Systems Inc said on Monday it will merge with Precept Investors Inc of Dallas to create a company with annual sales of $150 million.
Precept stockholders would receive 36 million U.S. Transportation shares, bringing the total number of outstanding shares to 45 million.
U.S. Transportation operates and manages transportation systems for private industry, municipalities and airports.
Precept is a distributor of business forms and product-management systems, and also offers transportation and courier services.
